summary: Fixed CHK-coverage: added one test that drives the split-button ResizeObserver callback (positive width, zero width, empty entries, disconnect on unmount), which was the only uncovered code. Line coverage is now 99.51% (baseline 98.97%); 227 tests pass. No production code changed.

tests.name: R3: an icon element is created once and the same reference is reused on every lookup
R3: a hundred built-in buttons render one icon each and keep the module-level elements on re-render
R3: every built-in type renders its icon in the shared style
R3: a disabled button dims the icon with the text instead of leaving it at full strength
R6: the 19 existing types keep their variant, button style, icon side and options
R6: a provider override of a built-in type's iconLeft keeps the app's own icon
R6 and R8: a new type icon and the toggle check coexist without replacing each other
R7: the features table lists exactly the built-in semantic types
R7: the docs use the new types and icon component, with no stale type count
R7: every documentation page links to the previous and next page
R1: all 47 built-in types render a default icon and keep their children label
R1: an app that registered a custom configuration for a new name keeps its own configuration
R1: an unknown semanticType renders a plain button without an icon
R1: a name in capitals or with spaces is not treated as a built-in type
R1: lists all 47 built-in names and every one has a defaults entry
R2: a developer-supplied iconLeft wins and the default icon is not added twice
R2: a developer-set variant wins over the built-in default
R2: no new type asks for confirmation by default
R2: next places its icon after the label so right-to-left layouts mirror it
R2: only the eight async new types get a 500 ms busy time and none ask for confirmation
R4: every built-in icon is hidden from screen readers and not focusable
R4: an icon-only button with aria-label announces that label, not the icon
R4: every built-in type gets the shared keyboard focus ring in light and dark themes
R5: two ZestIcons on one page do not clash (no shared ids)
R5: a rem size or a size name scales the icon without px
R5: renders the named built-in icon in the shared style
R8: an icon added later without the shared view box or stroke settings fails the style test
R8: no icon carries a script, event handler, external link, image or raw HTML
R8: every built-in icon uses the shared view box and stroke settings
R3: the dropdown width follows the observed size and ignores a zero width
